metrics.basis: selected method round JSON, composite-selected or standalone Judge PairJudgeResult JSON, frozen ledger L labels, and provider-free stage-loss evaluation

judge_billing.reason: Totals are sums of preserved Judge CallReceipt usage/retry rows; ineligible usage remains ineligible rather than estimated.

method_billing.basis: method cell llm_calls[].cost and attempts[] receipts
method_billing.reason: Totals are sums of preserved method llm_calls cost/attempt receipts; missing usage is never priced by evaluator inference.

predicate_usage.basis: method predicate_execution_receipts and Judge full_report_ids joined through original method issue IDs
predicate_usage.reason: Usage requires execution_status=executed, terminal_state=completed, and pass/violation; planned usage is counted only over the fixed 12-predicate scope, while nonplanned terminal receipts remain separately visible.

metrics.reason: FULL hits, W-on-hits, W2/all-expected, K/N/I, predicate receipts, D, stage loss, and billing retain their own denominators and raw audit paths.

reason: The fixed 15-pair reference retains all three v60 rounds and composite-selected raw artifacts before the single new 15x1 run.

stage_loss_audit.basis: SHA-256 over exact UTF-8 artifact bytes and a repository-relative path; evaluator reads but never rewrites the source.
stage_loss_audit.reason: Provider-free stage-loss derivation for the v60 15-pair reference; it is outside final_results.
